detailed_description: The Name Generator creates a browser-side list of names from the built-in name data set. You can choose a gender filter, choose one of the available origin filters, select a result count of 1, 5, 10, 20, or 50, click Generate, and copy one generated name or copy the whole list. The tool uses the local generateNames helper and available origin list, but it does not provide phonetic controls, Markov mutations, syllable sliders, seed input, cultural etymology analysis, API-backed databases, entropy scores, CSV export, or linguistic metadata.
usage_steps: Choose a gender filter or leave it set to any gender.
Choose an available origin filter or leave it set to any origin.
Select how many names to generate.
Click Generate to create the list.
Copy a single name or copy all generated names when needed.
usage_examples: Generate a short list of names for placeholder users in a prototype.
Filter by gender and origin to narrow a brainstorming list.
Create up to 50 sample names and copy the whole list into notes.
Copy one generated name for a mock profile, story draft, or test fixture.
